title: Hyderabad
subtitle: Golconda Fort · Charminar · Ramoji Film City · Srisailam
inclusions: Both way SL Train Tickets (3AC upgrade available)
Non-AC Tempo Traveller/Bus for local sightseeing

travel.departure: CSMT Mumbai — 8:30 PM, 17 Jan | Pune Jn. — 1:15 AM, 18 Jan
travel.arrival: Reach Pune by 09:00 AM, 21 Jan | Reach Mumbai by 1:15 PM, 21 Jan

itinerary.title: Board Train from Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reporting Station: CSMT, Mumbai at 8:30 PM or Pune Junction at 1:15 AM. Board train for Hyderabad. Overnight train journey.

itinerary.title: Hyderabad Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Reach Hyderabad Deccan Railway Station by approximately 12:00 PM. Transfer to hotel, check in, freshen up. Visit Golconda Fort, Charminar, and Hussain Sagar Lake. Dinner and rest at hotel.

itinerary.title: Srisailam Darshan
itinerary.description: Start early by approximately 4:00 AM for Mallikarjun Jyotirlinga, Srisailam (one of the 12 Jyotirlingas and 18 Maha Shakti Peethas). Breakfast at local dhaba. Also visit Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Temple. Return to hotel, dinner and rest.

itinerary.title: Hyderabad Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Breakfast. Proceed for remaining Hyderabad sightseeing. Visit remaining attractions and explore the city. Dinner and overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check out. Board return train for Mumbai. Reach Mumbai. Return home with sweet memories!

advisory: Participants can buy Srisailam darshan passes online before the trip. SPARSH: ₹500, ATHISEEGHRA: ₹300, SEEGHRA: ₹150.
